scripts.build:e2e: cross-env TREEASE_WDIO_TEST=1 tauri build --debug --no-bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.wdio.conf.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'); const name=process.platform==='win32'?'Treease.exe':'Treease'; const source=path.resolve('../../target/debug',name); const target=path.resolve('src-tauri/target/debug',name); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(source,target); fs.chmodSync(target,0o755);"
